note: Both sets extract only Table 5.5-6 and both repeatedly scramble the two column blocks (the left block is the point-source/0 mas case for charges 4/6/8/10, the right block is the 1 mas case for charges 6/8/10), so many values are attached to the wrong charge or the wrong stellar-size condition. Set B gets more claims fully right — Defocus 4.6 nm (charge 6, 0 mas), Defocus 0.8 nm (charge 4, 0 mas), Defocus 32 nm (charge 10, 0 mas), Spherical 0.0049 nm (charge 4, 0 mas) and Tip-tilt 1.1 nm (charge 4, 0 mas) — plus two charge-10 values (36, 6.7 nm) that at least match real charge-10 cells. Set A has only three fully correct claims (Spherical 0.0049, Tip-tilt 1.1, Defocus 0.8, all charge 4 at 0 mas) and invents or misbinds more, e.g. 0.36/0.44/4.6 nm labelled charge 4, 36 nm labelled charge 8, 15 nm labelled charge 6, and 6.1 nm Tip-tilt labelled charge 4 at 1 mas. Both sets also bind charge-specific values to the vague entity 'charge 4 to 10', but Set A does this more often and with more wrong stellar-size conditions.
